run_split_table_batched_embeddings_bench: run a benchmark for the SplitTableBatchedEmbeddingBagsCodegen operator with backward pass and collect result metrics
create_op_args_for_data_generator: create operator arguments for the input data generator with num_tables, rows, dim, batch_size, pooling_factor, weighted, and weights_precision
build_split_table_batched_embedding_op: build the SplitTableBatchedEmbeddingBagsCodegen operator with table config, pooling mode, weights precision, and optimizer settings
create_op_executor_and_run: create an OpExecutor instance and run the operator workload with input args and kwargs to collect benchmark metrics
configure_backward_pass_benchmark: configure the benchmark to run both forward and backward pass using ExecutionPass.BACKWARD for the embedding bags operator
